text:
Harper: Heads-up — Foxglove POC saw a regression in first-token latency during a demo run earlier today (~09:12 PT). p50 went from ~170ms to ~800ms intermittently.
Ibrahim: hosted or dedicated? any config changes?
Harper: hosted, trial org. They enabled prefill following our quickstart and also bumped token limits.
Mina: can we get their prefill config + concurrency? small prefill windows with concurrent clients are usually the culprit.
Harper: customer pasted: `prefill: enabled, prefill_batch_window_ms: 250, max_prefill_tokens: 640`, concurrency ~16, model `redwood-3-small-q4`.
ops-bot: runtime `v2.14.0` rolled to `us-west-2` 08:55 PT. No infra alerts.
Ibrahim: any 429s seen during their run?
Harper: yes, brief 429 spike during the stress replay, then latency spikes afterward.
Mina: ask them to run the quick session diag and paste the snippet: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/diag/session/<sid>?fields=queue,kvcache,rate`
Harper: they returned: `queue_wait_ms=390, kvcache_hit=false, backend_ms=88, x-ratelimit-remaining=64`.
Mina: kvcache_hit=false + high queue_wait_ms => likely prefill write/read race across shards. Small batches create lots of KV writes that then miss for reads.
Rachelle: customer also sent a security questionnaire asking about KMS/HSM key control for model cache encryption. They're worried about data residency too.
sec-bot: note: Foxglove asked if cache keys can be stored in their KMS; current hosted offering uses Redwood-managed KMS but Dedicated/Private supports customer KMS/HSM.
Ibrahim: two parallel issues: 1) perf (prefill -> KV thrash), 2) security ask (KMS/HSM + residency). Sales ops — any constraints on promising credits?
sales-ops: we can offer a conditional POC credit (one day of hosted credits) if we reproduce the regression and the guided config change doesn't resolve within 24h. Need deal owner approval.
Mina: immediate mitigation options: A) disable prefill and re-run the demo to measure baseline; B) increase `prefill_batch_window_ms` to 900-1200ms to reduce KV write churn; C) set `prefill_strict_sequencing: true` to serialize writes per-session (safer but slower prefill).
Harper: customer tried quick disable and reported p50 ~240ms and no 429s during a 5-min replay.
Ibrahim: that strongly implicates prefill. Recommend controlled re-enable with `prefill_batch_window_ms=1000` while we watch KV hit-rate and per-shard queue lengths.
Rachelle: on the security thread they want a short note for their compliance team stating: (1) hosted uses Redwood-managed KMS, (2) Dedicated supports customer KMS (bring-your-own), (3) Private on-prem supports HSM integrations. Rachelle, can you confirm the wording?
Rachelle: confirmed. I'll paste approved blurb into the security questionnaire and link the security docs. Also asked about audit logs for cache read/writes — we'll provide the audit log export steps.
Mina: for the re-enable plan include exact API patch we want them to run and the diag command so we can gather quick snapshots. Use this snippet in the email: 
`PATCH /v1/projects/<proj>/settings`
`{ \"prefill\": { \"enabled\": true, \"prefill_batch_window_ms\": 1000, \"prefill_strict_sequencing\": false } }`
`curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/diag/session/<sid>?fields=queue,kvcache,rate`
Ibrahim: monitor items: kvcache hit-rate, per-shard queue_wait_ms, backend latency, and any `x-ratelimit-*` header dips. If re-enable fails, flip to strict sequencing and retest; if still bad, leave prefill disabled and advise app-layer prewarm.
sales-ops: I'll draft the conditional credit wording: \"Redwood will issue a one-day hosted usage credit if, after guided config changes and a 24-hour monitoring window, Foxglove still experiences first-token latency regressions tied to platform behavior.\" Need signed-off approval from deal owner before sending.
Harper: customer wants an immediate call to walk through the re-enable while we watch. Can the on-call infra engineer join in 20 min?
Mina: available. I'll bring the per-shard tail script.
Ibrahim: I'll prepare the KV dashboard links and a rollback snippet to disable prefill quickly: `PATCH /v1/projects/<proj>/settings -d '{\"prefill\":{\"enabled\":false}}'`.
Rachelle: I'll also update the security questionnaire response and add the KMS roadmap note that Dedicated/private options exist for their environment.
sec-bot: security note added to ticket #9198: \"Hosted uses Redwood KMS; Dedicated/Private supports customer-managed KMS/HSM. Audit log export available.\"
Harper: customer did the controlled re-enable during the call with `prefill_batch_window_ms=1000` and we watched for 15 min. Early numbers: p50 ~240-260ms, occasional p95 blips ~480ms, no 429s.
Ibrahim: good. continue to monitor for 2 more hours while they run typical traffic. If stable, document in ticket and proceed to close the perf thread.
Harper: customer still wants reassurance on keys/residency before they sign. Rachelle, can you escalate the security paperwork to our enterprise onboarding team and get estimated timelines for Dedicated/private setup?
Rachelle: yes, I'll open internal handoff and include timelines. Will update customer by EOD.
sales-ops: provisional credit approved pending deal owner sign-off. I'll add the credit clause to the POC agreement template.
Harper: thanks team — plan looks good. I'll paste minutes into the deal thread and attach the diagnostic snapshots. :thumbsup:
